notes: Read on the transportation product pages as the brief requires. The first two www.oracle.com pages both returned HTTP 403 (an Oracle error page with no product text), so under the two-blocks rule no further www.oracle.com page was requested and no other Oracle host was tried as a way around the block. Every claim is unverifiable for now; the three URLs in needs_browser_read (the product page, the explainer page and the third product URL the answers cite) should settle pricing basis, naming (Oracle Transportation Management Cloud, part of Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM), deployment and the Oracle ERP and Fusion Cloud SCM integrations. Not coded: Gartner Magic Quadrant leadership and other rankings, implementation timelines and cost estimates (six-figure, multi-million), capability lists, and lines that only name Oracle ERP as a best-fit condition; one hedged line (Oracle TM usually wins on native integration) was left out. Pass 2 (8 Oct): the three URLs were each read once in a real browser (the third redirected to the product page and carries the same text), and needs_browser_read is now empty. C05 is now true (the product page lists an Oracle Transportation Management Cloud data sheet); C01, C02, C03, C04 and C06 stay unverifiable because neither page states a price or pricing basis, an Oracle ERP or Fusion Cloud SCM integration, membership of an SCM suite in a sentence, or a cloud-native architecture. Added C07 (pricing, unverifiable): the 'Cost' line under the OTM heading in q3 Claude run 1 gives annual platform fees of $300,000 to $800,000, a price for the software; the implementation cost estimate on the same line stays uncoded as in pass 1. The gaps file's other lines are rankings, capability descriptions, best-fit conditions or generic ERP-integration remarks (integration with Oracle systems, ERP connectivity) that name no product, and were not coded. Reviewer: C04 (the page is filed under Oracle's SCM navigation) and C06 (a cloud edition exists, cloud-native is not stated) were held at unverifiable as judgement calls.
